items.title: Ramadan Begins Today as Saudi Arabia Confirms Crescent Moon Sighting
items.desc: Saudi Arabia confirmed the sighting of the crescent moon, marking the official start of Ramadan 1447 on February 18, 2026. Muslims worldwide begin the month-long fasting period.
items.desc_zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯確認觀測到新月，2026年齋戒月（Ramadan 1447）於2月18日正式開始，全球穆斯林開始為期一個月的齋戒。

items.title: Tarique Rahman Sworn In as Bangladesh Prime Minister
items.desc: Tarique Rahman officially became the Prime Minister of Bangladesh, marking the beginning of a new political era for the country.
items.desc_zh: Tarique Rahman 正式成為孟加拉國總理，標誌著該國政治新時代的開始。

items.title: US-Iran Indirect Talks: Preliminary Diplomatic Activities in Geneva
items.title_zh: 美國與伊朗間接會談前外交活動
items.desc: Oman's Foreign Minister met with US envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner in Geneva to prepare for upcoming US-Iran indirect negotiations.
items.desc_zh: 阿曼外長與美國特使Steve Witkoff及川普女婿Jared Kushner在日內瓦會面，為即將舉行的美伊間接會談做準備。

items.title: India and France Establish 'Special Global Strategic Partnership'
items.title_zh: 印度與法國建立「特殊全球戰略夥伴關係」
items.desc: The two countries announced closer strategic cooperation to address global instability. PM Modi stated AI models will be deployed globally to serve billions of users.
items.desc_zh: 兩國宣布建立更緊密的戰略合作關係，共同應對全球動盪局勢。莫迪總理表示AI模型將在全球部署，服務數十億用戶。

items.title: ByteDance Releases Doubao 2.0 AI Model
items.title_zh: 字節跳動發布豆包2.0 AI模型
items.desc: ByteDance has released Doubao 2.0 AI model, optimized for the 'agent era' with enhanced capabilities for autonomous task execution.
items.desc_zh: 中國字節跳動（ByteDance）發布 Doubao 2.0 AI模型，針對「代理時代」（agent era）進行優化。

items.title: China's Gold Investors: 60% Are New Players
items.title_zh: 中國黃金投資者調查顯示近六成是新玩家
items.desc: A survey of Chinese mainland gold investors shows nearly 60% are new players, and 70% don't buy gold jewelry, reflecting a shift toward investment-oriented purchases.
items.desc_zh: 中國大陸黃金投資者調查顯示，近六成是新玩家，七成不購買金飾，反映投資取向轉變。

items.title: Asian Markets Closed for Lunar New Year Holiday
items.title_zh: 亞洲多國股市因農曆新年假期休市
items.desc: Major Asian markets including China, Hong Kong, Singapore, Taiwan, and South Korea are closed for the Lunar New Year holiday, affecting global trading volumes.
items.desc_zh: 中國農曆新年假期導致中國、香港、新加坡、台灣、韓國等亞洲主要股市休市。

items.title: Global Memory Chip Shortage Crisis Warned by Tech Leaders
items.title_zh: 全球記憶體晶片短缺危機
items.desc: Musk (Tesla) and Cook (Apple) warn that AI boom causes severe DRAM shortage, potentially devastating corporate profits and disrupting production. Micron describes this bottleneck as 'unprecedented.'
items.desc_zh: 馬斯克（特斯拉）和庫克（蘋果）等多位科技領袖警告，AI熱潮導致DRAM記憶體嚴重短缺，可能重創企業利潤、打亂生產計劃。美光科技形容此瓶頸「前所未見」。

items.title: Apple Accepts Kioxia Memory Price Increase Agreement
items.title_zh: 蘋果接受記憶體大廠漲價協議
items.desc: Apple reportedly accepted Japanese memory giant Kioxia's price increase agreement with doubled prices and dynamic adjustment mechanism, directly impacting iPhone production costs.
items.desc_zh: 受全球記憶體短缺影響，蘋果據傳已接受日本記憶體大廠鎧俠（Kioxia）的漲價協議，價格翻倍且採動態調整機制，這將直接影響iPhone生產成本與利潤。

items.title: Gold and Silver Prices Decline on Reduced Liquidity
items.title_zh: 農曆新年影響貴金屬市場
items.desc: Gold and silver prices continue to decline due to reduced liquidity from Asian market closures. Easing geopolitical tensions also pressure precious metals.
items.desc_zh: 中國農曆新年假期導致亞洲主要股市休市，黃金和白銀價格因流動性降低而持續下跌，地緣政治緊張局勢緩解也對貴金屬造成壓力。

items.title: 2026 Global Market Outlook: Synchronized Rally Expected
items.desc: Analysts predict global liquidity, fiscal spending, and China's credit impulse are recovering, signaling synchronized gains in stocks, crypto, and real estate in 2026-27.
items.desc_zh: 分析師預測全球流動性、財政支出和中國信貸脈衝正在回升，預示2026-27年股市、加密貨幣和房地產將同步上漲。

items.title: Google Pixel 10a Officially Launched Today
items.desc: Google officially released the Pixel 10a smartphone on February 18. US carriers had already leaked full specifications. The device offers multiple colors with upgraded camera systems.
items.desc_zh: Google 於2月18日正式發布 Pixel 10a 智慧手機，美國電信商已提前洩露完整規格。新機將提供多種顏色選擇並搭載升級相機系統。

items.title: AI Film Academy Trains Next Generation of Hollywood Creatives
items.title_zh: AI電影學院培養好萊塢新血
items.desc: AI film academies specializing in training next-generation Hollywood filmmakers are emerging, teaching how to use AI technology for film production.
items.desc_zh: 專門培訓下一代好萊塢電影製作人的AI電影學校正興起，教導如何使用AI技術進行電影創作。

items.title: Saks Global Files for Bankruptcy Protection
items.desc: Luxury retail giant Saks Global filed for bankruptcy reorganization, planning to leverage its premium real estate portfolio as leverage in negotiations with lenders.
items.desc_zh: 奢侈零售巨頭Saks Global申請破產重組，計劃利用其優質房地產組合作為與貸款人談判的籌碼。
